key.name: save-folder
key.description: Where Ctrl+S puts new captures. Empty means ~/Pictures/Annota.

key.name: filename-pattern
key.description: strftime-style pattern used to name quick-saved captures.

key.name: export-folder
key.description: Folder offered by the export dialog. Empty means the save folder's Exports subfolder.

key.name: include-pointer
key.summary: Include the mouse pointer in captures

key.name: capture-all-monitors
key.description: Screen mode captures every monitor instead of the one under the pointer.

key.name: shortcut-region
key.description: Global shortcut (GTK accelerator syntax) that starts a region capture. Empty disables it.

key.name: shortcut-window
key.description: Global shortcut (GTK accelerator syntax) that starts a window capture. Empty disables it.

key.name: shortcut-screen
key.description: Global shortcut (GTK accelerator syntax) that starts a screen capture. Empty disables it.

key.name: gnome-shortcuts-created
key.description: Whether Annota has written GNOME custom keybindings that run annota --capture (used when the GlobalShortcuts portal is unavailable).

key.name: moved-gnome-keys
key.description: GNOME Shell keybindings (key, accelerator) that Annota took over. They are given back when the Annota shortcut is disabled or changed.
